issue.title: Prepare Offline: persist Reference Images as kind:image in download_queue for Resources offline gating
issue.body:
## Summary / context

Device QA on [#364](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/364) (fix for [#348](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/348)) confirmed Settings / account-switch fixes, but **Images & Maps offline AC remains blocked**.

After Prepare for Offline shows **Reference Images** as completed, airplane mode hides the Images & Maps accordion entirely — TN/TQ appear as downloaded, but no section-level "Images unavailable" + Retry.

Root cause (outside #364 scope): Prepare Offline persists Reference Images in `download_queue` as `kind: text`, while Resources offline gating requires `kind: image` for the `imagesMaps` slot ([#192](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/192) / [#201](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/201) inventory wiring).

## Root cause (code)

1. `src/utils/prepareOfflineQueueMapping.ts` — `queueKindForResource()` collapses non-audio kinds to `'text'` (including catalog `kind: 'image'`).
2. `src/db/downloadQueueRepository.ts` — `EnqueueDownloadItemInput.kind` is typed `'text' | 'audio'` only (no `'image'`).
3. `src/services/resourcesInventory.ts` + `src/utils/resourcesSectionInventory.ts` — `imagesMaps` gate matches `resourceName: 'Reference Images'` **and** `kind: 'image'`.

Prepare Offline UI can show Reference Images completed while Resources never enables Images offline.

## Scope

**In scope**
- Extend download queue / enqueue path to persist `kind: 'image'` for Reference Images (and any other image-tier resources)
- Fix queue mapping so manifest `kind: 'image'` survives enqueue
- Resources `imagesMaps` section appears offline after Prepare Offline completes Reference Images
- Unit tests for mapping + inventory gate alignment
- Android device QA: Prepare Offline complete → airplane mode → Images & Maps visible (with content or section Retry)

**Out of scope**
- #348 navigation reset + online Retry UX (landed in #364)
- Broader offline auth durability (#291)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Reference Images enqueue to `download_queue` with `kind: 'image'` (not `'text'`)
- [ ] After successful Prepare Offline download, `getDownloadedResourceSections()` includes `imagesMaps`
- [ ] Airplane mode: Images & Maps accordion is visible for a project with completed Reference Images download
- [ ] Existing TN/TQ/audio queue behavior unchanged
- [ ] Unit tests cover image kind mapping and inventory gate
- [ ] Android device QA recorded on the PR

## Verification / test plan

1. Online: Genesis 1 with images → confirm Images & Maps shows thumbnails.
2. Prepare for Offline: complete all tiers including Reference Images.
3. Airplane mode → Resources → same verse: TN/TQ show downloaded; **Images & Maps accordion appears** (content or Retry).
4. Gates: `format:check` → `lint` → `typecheck` → `npm test -- --ci`

## Links

- Discovered in QA review: https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/364#pullrequestreview-5046685538
- Parent QA defect: #348 (AC1 offline remains open until this lands)
- Inventory wiring: #192 (closed), queue foundation: #201 (closed)
- Key files: `prepareOfflineQueueMapping.ts`, `downloadQueueRepository.ts`, `resourcesSectionInventory.ts`, `resourcesInventory.ts`
